# Hydra Sync 1.6.0

Automatic syncing is now opt-in: nothing runs on a timer until you turn it on.

## What's new

### Auto-sync switch (off by default)

A new **Auto-sync** setting controls every automatic pass:

- **Off (default)** — Hydra Sync only syncs when you ask it to, via **Sync now** in the
  `@Hydra Sync` main menu or the per-game menu actions
- **On** — one pass runs shortly after Playnite starts, then repeats on the interval you
  set (1–1440 minutes, default 15)

Turning it on or off, or changing the interval, takes effect as soon as you save the
settings — the timer is rescheduled without needing a Playnite restart. The interval
field is only meaningful while Auto-sync is enabled.

### Why it changed

Playtime and achievements are both replaced with Hydra's values when Hydra has more, so
scheduled passes can change your library without you being at the keyboard. Defaulting
them off keeps the extension predictable and quiet; if you want a hands-off library,
flip the switch once and it stays that way.

## Upgrade notes

- **Behavior change:** automatic (timer-based) syncing no longer runs after this update
  until you enable **Auto-sync** in **Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra
  Sync**. Manual syncing is unchanged.
- Nothing to re-sync. Existing playtime state, per-game data and settings values are kept
  as-is; enabling Auto-sync resumes scheduled passes immediately after saving.

## Install

1. Download `HydraSync-1.6.0.pext` from the assets below.
2. Double-click it and confirm the install (or extract it into
   `%APPDATA%\Playnite\Extensions\A76358E9-BFA2-4189-B6F3-2307EA4E217B\`).
3. Restart Playnite.

Settings live at **Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra Sync**.
